title: Provide or update your partnership details for VAT
text:
When to use form VAT2 

 Use form VAT2 to: 

 • provide details of partners when you register for VAT

 • update partner details

 • add and remove partners

 • confirm that partners agree to change a partnership’s bank account

 You can add 8 partners’ details to each VAT2 form. If you have more partners, you’ll need to send extra forms.

 What you’ll need 

 You’ll need: 

 • your VAT registration number, if you have one

 • your business name

 • partners’ details, such as date of birth and National Insurance number

 • partners’ signatures

 How to fill in and send the form 

 • 
 Print the VAT2 form (PDF, 262 KB, 2 pages) .

 • 
 Fill in the registration number (if known), business name and reason for sending. 

 • 
 Get each partner to fill in and sign one of the 8 sections.

 • 
 Upload the form when you register for VAT  or post it to the  VAT registration applications and changes  team. 

 This form may not be suitable if you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader). If you need a more accessible format, email different.format@hmrc.gov.uk and tell us what format you need. It will help if you tell us what assistive technology you use. Read the  accessibility statement for HMRC forms . 

 After you send the form 

 Once we’ve checked your form, we’ll let you know the outcome by post or online in your business tax account.

 Find out  when you can expect a reply from HMRC .
